title: Train hopping callback waits for a getter read
evidence: Both start with current=0.2, next=0.8 and zero callbacks; setting next to 0.1 crosses the current train. At frame 1 Flutter has 1 switch callback and Incular 0. A later currentTrain read makes Incular emit it, matching again at frame 2.
impact: A consumer that depends on the switch callback but does not read the composed animation never receives it, and dependent state can stay stale. If it reads later, the callback runs late and inside the getter call.
cause: The Rust implementation samples the parents lazily instead of subscribing to their changes.
fix_direction: Observe parent value changes and perform the hop and callback when the crossing occurs, respecting callback reentrancy and disposal.
limitations: One crossing direction and the default two-train configuration are checked; disposal and reentrancy are not.

title: AlwaysStoppedAnimation accepts only scalar values
evidence: Source review. Incular defines AlwaysStoppedAnimation(pub f32) and returns f32 through AnimationSource. crates/incular-animation/tests/animation_graph.rs checks the scalar value and forward status only.
impact: A Flutter caller can supply a fixed color, size or other object as an animation value; the Incular type cannot represent it directly.
cause: The composition source abstraction is specialized to f32.
fix_direction: Provide a typed fixed animation and a compatible typed animation interface for non-scalar values.
limitations: Source-only; no typed animation exists to run a frame twin against.

title: CurvedAnimation can latch the wrong curve before its first running read
evidence: Both controllers start forward, set to 0.5 and reverse without reading the curved value. At frame 1 Flutter reports 0.3164 (ease-in) and Incular 0.6836 (ease-out); max difference 0.3672. crates/incular-animation/tests/flutter_animation_parity.rs:213 covers a latch with sampled values but not this unobserved sequence.
impact: The next observed animated value jumps to the reverse curve after a forward run is reversed before the curved value was sampled, instead of staying on the forward curve.
cause: The lazy update observes only the current reverse status and misses the earlier forward status change; no endpoint was reached between them.
fix_direction: Track status changes when they occur, including unobserved direction changes, and preserve the initial direction until the parent reaches an endpoint.
limitations: One reversal sequence with the default curves is checked.
